Milia also referred to as “milk spots” are small, pearly white cysts that typically appear on the face around the lower eyelids, forehead, or cheeks. Milia occurs when dead skin cells and natural oils become trapped in the skin’s pores. 

There are many causes of milia which include: 
- Improper skin exfoliation can lead to buildup of keratin that can lead to milia
- Cosmetic products such as concealers, foundations, moisturizers that don’t suit your skin type
- Genetics
- Excessive sun exposure
